title: AIUnderlay theme
description: Appearance only. A theme can never change the Error > Waiting > Unread priority, invent quota windows, or alter monitoring data. Version 1 files keep working; version 2 adds the Glass Spectrum vocabulary.

schemaVersion.description: 1 = classic vocabulary (quotaLayers / states). 2 = Glass Spectrum (material / signals / attention, plus version 1 fields). Anything else is rejected rather than guessed at.

id.description: Stable identity of the theme. Must not contain path separators.

baselineEnabled.description: false hides the pace baseline. It can never switch it on against the user's own setting.

exhaustedTrackColor.description: v2: the bed under a known quota. Built-in default is opaque #000000.

providers.description: Keyed by provider id, e.g. codex, claude.

quotaLayers.description: Longest window first: index 0 is the outermost layer. Only as many layers as the provider really reports — never invent a month.

quotaBaseColor.description: v2: one base colour; the outer/middle/inner tier ladder derives from it. Mutually alternative to quotaLayers (explicit layers win).

agentThemeColor.description: v2: this provider's glass tint. Affects the glass material only — never quotas, never signal lights.

states.description: Version 1 vocabulary. Keyed by state: waiting, error (recovering may be added later). Version 2 files may still use these; signals win when both are present.

borderWidth.description: Top and bottom edge thickness, in points.

signals.description: v2: the four signal lights. Global semantics; the Error > Waiting > Unread priority is a code constant and cannot be reordered here.

material.description: v2: the glass material, as renderer targets.

blurRadiusTarget.description: Softness target in points, carried over from the V5 lab (17).

attention.description: v2: the alert ribbon geometry and sweep tempos.
